final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required ISO format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also handled repeated messages by summing the repeat counts from the following lines. Finally, I aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
